notes.title: Update Version 1.01
notes.content:
Thank you for playing NARIBIKIMURA.
Today, we have implemented the following updates:

[list]
[*]Fixed an issue where the screen would blur after certain camera effects when the frame rate was low.
[*]Corrected some text phrases.
[*]Fixed collisions that could potentially cause the player to get stuck.
[/list]

Thank you for your continued support.
